name: Revenue Forecast Model
summary: Projects MRR month by month under named scenarios of growth and churn, with ending ARR and total revenue per scenario.
description: Projects monthly recurring revenue from today's MRR for up to 60 months under up to five named scenarios, each with its own monthly growth and churn rate. The registered calculation compounds month by month to the cent and reports each scenario's schedule, ending MRR and ARR, and total revenue; the model compares the scenarios in words. Who it's for: founders and finance leads building a simple forecast for planning, hiring or fundraising. Limitations: rates are constant within a scenario (no seasonality, ramps or step changes); it forecasts subscription revenue only, not costs or cash.
problems: I need a revenue forecast with scenarios
Where will our MRR be in 12 months
I want base, upside and downside revenue projections

inputs.label: Scenarios
inputs.description: One scenario per line: name, monthly growth % and monthly churn %.
inputs.example:
Base: 5% growth, 2% churn
Downside: 1% growth, 3% churn

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Read your data
steps.responsibility: Copy your figures into the calculation's input exactly as written.
steps.prompt: Read each scenario: its name, monthly growth % and monthly churn %. Copy the percentages exactly as written.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered revenue_forecast@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Compare the scenarios: how far apart they end, what drives the gap, and which assumptions matter most. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
Every number in the key points comes from the calculation or your inputs.
The summary is 90 words or fewer.
